page: Amazon Web Services m6id.12xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz, delivering 24 physical cores and 48 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Compute capacity is backed by 54 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and support for hardware vector instructions including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI, along with cryptographic extensions like AES and VAES.

Memory capacity is configured with 192.0 GB of DDR4 RAM operating at 3 GHz, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. For high-speed temporary storage, the instance bundles 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store capacity. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 19 Gbps, though no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-threaded execution and cryptographic capabilities. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 15999.0 and a PassMark CPU encryption score of 43553.35, both ranking in the top 25 percent. In graphical and media processing, Geekbench ray tracing reached 49239.0 and image processing recorded 15128.0. For AI workloads, small model (135M) LLM text generation achieved a strong 297.19 tokens per second, though large model (70B) text generation fell to 2.72 tokens per second, placing it in the lower 25 percent without dedicated accelerators. Throughput benchmarks show solid general capacity, including 45.51 million Redis SET operations per second and 41.18 GB/sec in static web serving.

The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, 192 GB RAM, and 2850 GB of integrated NVMe storage makes this configuration cost-efficient for I/O-intensive workloads needing local disk caching without paying separate block storage rates. Appropriate workloads include mid-tier relational and NoSQL databases, distributed caching layers, build and CI/CD pipelines, static web serving clusters, and batch data processing.

Built on the AWS Nitro system, it includes 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory providing 4.0 GB per core, along with 2850 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD instance storage and a 19 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results show strong performance in multi-core metrics, CPU encryption, and image processing, alongside solid throughput reaching 45.51 million Redis operations per second. While unaccelerated CPU execution limits large-scale model inference, its integrated NVMe storage and balanced memory ratio eliminate separate block storage overhead for temporary files. The instance is suited for caching layers, database clusters, build environments, and data processing tasks.
